correctness.rationale: Single-disk monomial diagonalization gives λ0=1−e^(−s), λ1=1−(1+s)e^(−s), gap δ=se^(−s). For the disjoint restriction B=(Ba,Bb), nonzero spectrum of B*B agrees with BB*. The normalized disk-top vectors compress BB* to 2×2 with off-diagonal λ0<ka,kb> of modulus λ0 exp(−d²/2). A cross-disk kernel Hilbert–Schmidt integral bounds ||C||≤s exp(−(d−2√s)²/2)=η. For η<δ/4, min–max and Schur-complement spectral inertia bound the positive errors to both λ0(1±ε) by η²/(δ−2η). Since η²/e^(−d²/2)→0 for fixed s, sharp coefficient λ0 and the gap asymptotic follow. Independent checks recover gap/overlap/error order; source CHECKER.py is finite Galerkin only and was not used as proof.
